buildCommand: bunx prisma db push && SCCS_DB_DIRECT=1 INITIAL_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123 bun prisma/seed.ts && node -e "const n=require('fs').statSync('db/sccs.db').size; if (n < 500000) { console.error('Seeded db/sccs.db is only ' + n + ' bytes'); process.exit(1) }" && next build
